run.name: VSE Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (VSEC)
run.summary: VSE is a profitable but newly stretched aviation aftermarket credit: net debt is 3.04x trailing adjusted EBITDA after a large acquisition, liquidity is adequate, and the outcome hinges on integration and year-end cash flow. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is VSE CORP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 978,793 and net debt 913,007 over TTM Adjusted EBITDA 300,387 (S7 page:7), which includes five months of PAG. On management's TTM Acquisition Adjusted EBITDA of 389,234 the ratios are 2.51 and 2.35; that figure has no component schedule. Covenant definitions not supplied.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Management Adjusted EBITDA 182,924 (S7 page:7) over cash paid for interest 26,849 (S1 page:44). Cash interest is a consolidated cash flow figure that includes discontinued operations in 2025.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash (S4 page:4); unused commitments after USD 20.0 million drawn and USD 0.8 million letters of credit (S4 page:32). Revolver matures 2030-05-02.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.

CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, the credit agreement and 2026 cash interest are missing, so headroom and cash interest cover cannot be measured; acquisition-adjusted earnings are management's figure.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels, amended-facility margins and 2026 cash interest are not in the pack, and acquisition-adjusted earnings are a management figure with no schedule.
